whatEnjoy: Solving puzzles and writing small programs
whatTried: Python basics and a small team project using Git and GitHub Issues
whatCurious: Web development and how to build apps that people actually use

items.title: Number Guessing Game
items.description: Wrote a small Python game where the computer picks a secret number and gives hints until the player guesses it.

reflection.whatIDid: Wrote the game loop, the hint messages and a counter for the number of guesses.
reflection.whatILearned: How loops and conditions work together, and how to test a program with different inputs.
reflection.challenge: An infinite loop appeared when the player typed text instead of a number. I traced it with print statements and added a check that asks again when the input is not a number.
reflection.nextStep: Add a high-score list and difficulty levels.

items.title: Library Book Tracker (Group Mini Project)
items.description: Worked in a team of four to plan a small web page for tracking borrowed library books, and built the form and the book list section.

reflection.whatIDid: Built the book form, wrote the code that shows the list and committed my work to the team repository.
reflection.whatILearned: How to split tasks with GitHub Issues and pull the latest changes before editing.
reflection.challenge: A merge conflict happened when two of us edited the same file. We compared both versions together, kept the correct lines and agreed to pull before editing from then on.
reflection.nextStep: Add a due-date reminder and save the list in the browser.
